     if (input.len == 0 or input.len > 900_000) return error.InvalidBzip2Stream;
     const order_a = try allocator.alloc(u32, input.len);
     defer allocator.free(order_a);
+    // Reuse the first eventual order array for KMP before allocating the
+    // remaining generic scratch. A prefix period must divide the entire input.
+    order_a[0] = 0;
+    for (1..input.len) |index| {
+        var prefix: usize = order_a[index - 1];
+        while (prefix != 0 and input[index] != input[prefix])
+            prefix = order_a[prefix - 1];
+        if (input[index] == input[prefix]) prefix += 1;
+        order_a[index] = @intCast(prefix);
+    }
+    const period = input.len - order_a[input.len - 1];
+    if (period < input.len and input.len % period == 0) {
+        const base = try transformAlloc(allocator, input[0..period]);
+        defer base.deinit(allocator);
+        const repeated = input.len / period;
+        const transformed = try allocator.alloc(u8, input.len);
+        errdefer allocator.free(transformed);
+        for (base.bytes, 0..) |byte, row|
+            @memset(transformed[row * repeated ..][0..repeated], byte);
+        var power: usize = 1;
+        while (power < input.len) power *= 2;
+        const tie_rank = ((power - 1) / period) % repeated;
+        return .{
+            .bytes = transformed,
+            .original_pointer = @intCast(@as(usize, base.original_pointer) * repeated + tie_rank),
+        };
+    }
